tasks.short: Create master patterns across garment sizes

steps.what: Verify base-pattern measurements and the size chart
Choose grade rules and resolve construction and fit exceptions
Repeat specified point and seam grading for each required size
Check all size patterns for measurements, construction and fit and save masters

tasks.design: Configure native grading in the apparel CAD system represented by {OTHER} from the patternmaker's checked base and chosen rules. Repeat only the specified geometry across sizes, retaining rule choice, fit judgement, complete size checks and ordinary master saves.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specified grade movements can be repeated manually across every size.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAD grade-rule tables and repeat operations.
tasks.still_hard: Construction changes and fit exceptions that do not follow a simple size increment.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a technically consistent grade that distorts the intended garment.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated grading, with master-pattern responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: apparel CAD grading can repeat specified grade rules across sizes, while rule choice and fit assessment remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe actual repeated manual grading, not already automatic native grading or computational runtime. Paper-only work needs its own graph.

Design development supplies the base pattern, garment requirements and size chart. s1 includes actual measurement and verification of points, seams, units and size identifiers; missing measurements remain manual. s2 supplies exact grade rules before s3.

Test native grading first. Thirty removed points are actual repeated specified point movements and seam updates, not selecting fit or adapting construction. Unsupported features remain manually handled in s2/s4.

All complete checks and ordinary same-system master saves remain fully retained without self-approval gates. Actual sample making, if needed for fit checking, must be counted rather than assumed free.
unknowns: Compatibility of base patterns and rule tables
research_questions: Which point movements are still repeated manually after native grading is used?

incremental.description: Maintain grade-rule tables and known-size checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 30 repeat-grading points less 1 upkeep gives 29. An asymmetric garment with incompatible construction across sizes leaves only 8 points of standard seam/point grading reusable, with all exceptions retained, giving 7 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read and verify source specifications and their destination field mapping
Re-key the specified fields into the pattern-design application
Check every imported specification against the source and save the working version

tasks.design: Test native specification import in the apparel CAD system represented by {OTHER}, using exact fields from the checked design source. Transfer into a working draft only, keeping field interpretation, missing-field repair, full source comparison and ordinary save human; do not command cutting equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Structured specifications may be manually re-keyed into a separate design application.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import or deterministic field mapping where both formats are supported.
tasks.still_hard: Units, revision mismatches and design terminology that does not map directly.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a plausible imported value belonging to the wrong size or design revision.
tasks.altitude: Less re-keying, with specification responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured specification import can replace actual re-keying while interpretation and complete source checks remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover actual specification entry from an existing structured source, not a same-system save or already automatic import.

The designer supplies style, revision, size, measurement identifiers, values, units and construction/cutting attributes. s1 verifies the source and maps fields; absent fields or unsupported terminology are manually resolved in s1/s3.

Test native import first. s2 removes actual re-keying into a distinct application, not design decisions or cutting-machine runtime. An unstructured or paper source retains manual capture and needs a lower reweighted estimate.
s3 retains every source comparison and ordinary ungated author save. No cutter execution or production release occurs in this input task.
unknowns: Actual source structure and import support
research_questions: Can one real specification preserve style, revision, size and units exactly through import?

incremental.description: Maintain specification mappings and import regression checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 45 re-key points less 1.5 upkeep gives 43.5. With legacy source sheets and mostly unsupported fields, retain capture and interpretation; only 5 points of exact structured numeric entry transfer, giving 3.5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draw pattern-part outlines from existing or new designs

steps.what: Select and verify the existing pattern or new design geometry
Draft new or adapted pattern geometry and construction details
Copy exact reusable digital outlines into the selected pattern parts
Check all outlines, seams and notches and save the working pattern

tasks.design: Use native part-library insertion in the apparel CAD environment represented by {OTHER} for exact parts the patternmaker has selected. Keep new drafting, adaptations and full seam/notch checks human; no geometry is inferred from a design name.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exact existing outlines can be retraced or reconstructed manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable digital parts and exact geometry insertion.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting construction while preserving fit and the intended silhouette.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise where an apparently similar pattern part needs a substantive change.
tasks.altitude: Less exact copying, retaining pattern-design judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: apparel CAD part libraries can reuse exact digital outlines, while new drafting and adaptations remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe an actual mixed adaptation/copying assignment. A wholly new drafted pattern must remove reusable-part work and reweight the graph.

Existing pattern development supplies identified parts with style, revision, units, seam and notch geometry. s1 verifies these and includes manual measurement/digitising where needed; s2 chooses exact reusable parts. No ready digital outline is invented from a paper pattern.

Test native part insertion first. s3 removes exact copying only, not selecting, adapting, tracing unsupported paper sources or evaluating fit. Source conversion repair remains retained in s1/s2/s4 or lowers the estimate.
All final checks and ordinary working-pattern save remain retained without an approval gate. No production release is included.
unknowns: Availability of compatible digital source parts
Proportion of work that is original drafting
research_questions: Which exact outline copying remains manual despite the native part library?

incremental.description: Maintain reusable-part identifiers and revision checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 exact-copy points less 1 upkeep gives 19. With old paper patterns and new construction details, only 4 points of compatible existing digital outlines can be reused; retain all digitising and adaptation, giving 3 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create a production paper pattern from a design concept

steps.what: Interpret the design concept and establish required dimensions and construction
Draft the actual master pattern geometry and construction marks
Arrange specified pattern pieces and labels for the paper output format
Check final scale, labels, piece completeness and the specified plotter target
Send the exact authorised plot package to the paper plotter
Handle, cut and assemble the actual paper pattern
Check the actual paper pattern against the master and design requirements

tasks.design: Use native paper-layout presets in the apparel CAD and plotter environment represented by {OTHER} for repeated piece arrangement and labels. Keep concept interpretation, pattern drafting, exact final-output checking and physical paper preparation human, with the actual plotter send gated on the final package.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated paper-output arrangement can be manual around original pattern drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native plot layouts and label presets.
tasks.still_hard: Translating a concept into correct construction and ensuring the physical output has the intended scale.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a design or paper-output problem before the pattern is used in production.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated output arrangement; master-pattern responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native plot layouts can arrange pattern pieces and labels, while drafting and physical paper validation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe a CAD-to-paper production pattern, not a purely hand-drafted pattern. Existing automatic layout or plotter runtime earns no labour saving.

s1 supplies design dimensions, construction and required piece list, and the paper output specification including scale and media width. s2 creates actual geometry. Missing design facts require manual clarification, never inferred measurements.
Test native plot presets first. Ten removed points are actual repeated output arrangement and label placement; original drafting, physical handling and full checks remain.

s4 checks the exact final package and plotter before s5; edits void approval. This is a real equipment send, not an ordinary author save. Ordinary working-file saves are retained within drafting without approval.
No extra pattern-completion log is invented. This is a separate production-pattern instance from reusable outline copying and grading; a roll-up must not count the same geometry twice.
unknowns: Compatibility of plotter formats and paper sizes
research_questions: Which layout and label interactions still require manual work before plotting?

incremental.description: Maintain plotter format and label presets

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final plot package, scale, paper format and plotter target; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10 output-arrangement points less 0.8 upkeep gives 9.2. With an incompatible legacy plotter format, retain most arrangement and repair; only 2 points of reusable label placement disappear, giving 1.2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep fit, construction and design judgement while reusing exact compatible geometry and specification fields.
role.ambitious_version: Use verified repeated-interaction savings for closer construction and fit checks.
